facts.text: Zhenyu asked to make a message more polite addressed to Tyra.
Zhenyu asked whether Tyra can be the contact for weekly catering for a group meeting.
Zhenyu said the catering order would be placed from O's campus cafe.
Zhenyu said O's requires a faculty or staff member as the contact.
Zhenyu said O's will send Tyra a proposal after Zhenyu submits the catering inquiry.
Zhenyu said Tyra would need to forward the proposal to Zhenyu for checking.
Zhenyu said Tyra would need to reply with approval.
Zhenyu said O's will send Tyra the receipt after the catering.
Zhenyu said they would continue with reimbursement after receiving the receipt.
